audience: salon and operations teams using Cliento

useCases.title: Compare service prices and durations
useCases.text: Review the service catalog and compare how different resources offer each service, including their duration and price overrides.

useCases.title: Review tracked product stock
useCases.text: List products and inspect current balances for stock-tracked items. A missing balance is not treated as zero stock.

useCases.title: Trace recorded stock changes
useCases.text: Review stock movements for a product, following the recorded changes from oldest to newest. Newly created movements may take about ten seconds to appear.

useCases.title: Inspect resource configuration
useCases.text: Review resources, their display groups and online-booking settings when checking how the resource catalog is configured.

useCases.title: Review colour bar inventory
useCases.text: Inspect supplier ranges, shade items, barcodes and pack balances for a location’s colour bar catalog.
